What if a black hole the size of a marble appeared in your room?
A black hole that small would weigh as much as the entire Earth.
One metre away, its pull would be forty trillion times stronger than gravity.
You, the furniture, the walls… everything would fall in faster than you could blink.
Squeezed around it, all that matter would heat up and flash brighter than the Sun.
And the black hole would pull on Earth just as hard as Earth pulls on it. The whole planet would start falling in.
Bit by bit, Earth would be torn apart, swirling around it in a glowing disk.
All from something smaller than a coin. What would you do in that last second? Tell me in the comments.
